title: Numbing Brazilian Paneer Curry
description: A fiery Brazilian-inspired paneer curry that blends shiso leaves, a fiery temper, and Ayurvedic sattvic-friendly ingredients into a cheese-pull, weeknight delight.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add cumin and mustard seeds, letting them crackle for 30 seconds.
Stir in minced garlic, grated ginger, and shiso leaves, cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add red chili powder and turmeric, mixing well to coat the aromatics.
Pour in coconut milk and fresh lime juice, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Gently fold in cubed paneer, then cover and simmer for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Season with salt to taste, adjusting the balance of spice and acidity.
Reduce heat to low, letting the curry thicken slightly while keeping the paneer soft.
Serve hot, garnishing with extra shiso leaves and a squeeze of lime if desired.
Pair with steamed rice or warm flatbread for a complete meal.
